youtube.title: What Darwin Really Thought About Human Nature
youtube.description:
What Darwin really thought about human nature: he thought people are animals who learned to be kind.

Notebook B, Jemmy Button, Origin, Descent of Man, and why Social Darwinism is not the book he wrote about conscience.

This illustrated documentary from What They Really Think tells that story.
